q.en: What is the main idea of this book?

options.en: Only babies need sleep
options.zh: 只有婴儿需要睡觉

options.en: Food is more important than sleep because the body can live without rest
options.zh: 食物比睡眠更重要，因为身体可以不必休息而存活

options.en: Sleep is a waste of time
options.zh: 睡觉是在浪费时间

options.en: Sleep helps our bodies and brains rest and grow
options.zh: 睡眠帮助我们的身体和大脑休息与成长

explain.en: The book shows that sleep is important for everyone because it restores the body and mind
explain.zh: 书中说明睡眠对每个人都很重要，因为它能让身体和大脑恢复

q.en: What does our brain do while we sleep?
q.zh: 我们睡觉的时候，大脑在做什么？

options.en: It only dreams of food, especially pizza and ice cream
options.zh: 它只梦到食物，尤其是披萨和冰淇淋

options.en: It sorts and stores what we learned that day
options.zh: 它整理并储存我们当天学到的东西

options.en: It stops working forever
options.zh: 它永远停止工作

options.en: It shuts off completely
options.zh: 它完全关闭了

explain.en: The book explains that during sleep the brain files away memories and gets ready for the next day
explain.zh: 书中解释，睡眠期间大脑会把记忆归档，并为新的一天做好准备

q.en: How does sleep help a child's body?
q.zh: 睡眠如何帮助孩子的身体？

options.en: It makes the body smaller
options.zh: 它让身体变小

options.en: It turns the body to stone while you are asleep
options.zh: 它在你睡着时把身体变成石头

options.en: It helps the body grow and repair itself
options.zh: 它帮助身体成长并自我修复

options.en: It has no effect
options.zh: 它没有任何作用

explain.en: The book notes that growth and healing happen while we sleep, which is why children need plenty of rest
explain.zh: 书中提到成长与修复发生在我们睡眠时，所以孩子需要充足休息

q.en: What can happen if you do not get enough sleep?
q.zh: 如果睡眠不足会发生什么？

options.en: You grow taller instantly by several inches each night
options.zh: 你每晚会立刻长高好几英寸

options.en: You may feel tired and have trouble thinking
options.zh: 你可能会感到疲倦，并且难以思考

options.en: You become a superhero
options.zh: 你变成超级英雄

options.en: Nothing changes
options.zh: 什么都不会改变

explain.en: The book warns that too little sleep leaves people cranky, sleepy, and unable to focus well
explain.zh: 书中提醒，睡眠太少会让人烦躁、困倦，并且难以集中注意力

q.en: What is a 'circadian rhythm' mentioned in the book?
q.zh: 书中提到的“昼夜节律”是什么？

options.en: A sport
options.zh: 一项运动

options.en: The body's natural day-and-night sleep cycle
options.zh: 身体自然的昼夜睡眠周期

options.en: A kind of musical beat that plays while we rest
options.zh: 一种在我们休息时播放的音乐节拍

options.en: A type of food
options.zh: 一种食物

explain.en: The book describes the circadian rhythm as the internal clock that tells us when to be awake and when to sleep
explain.zh: 书中把昼夜节律描述为一种内在时钟，告诉我们何时清醒、何时入睡

q.en: Why do we dream while we sleep?
q.zh: 我们为什么会在睡觉时做梦？

options.en: Dreams never happen
options.zh: 做梦从不发生

options.en: The brain is busy sorting thoughts and memories
options.zh: 大脑正忙着整理思绪和记忆

options.en: Because the moon commands it to send secret messages
options.zh: 因为是月亮命令它发送秘密信息

options.en: Because the bed is magic
options.zh: 因为床有魔力

explain.en: The book links dreaming to the brain's nighttime work of processing the day's experiences
explain.zh: 书中把做梦与大脑在夜间处理一天经历的工作联系起来

q.en: What is one tip the book gives for better sleep?
q.zh: 书中给出的一个改善睡眠的建议是什么？

options.en: Drink soda right before bed
options.zh: 睡前马上喝汽水

options.en: Keep a regular bedtime and calm routine
options.zh: 保持规律的作息和安静的睡前 routine

options.en: Watch loud TV all night to help the brain stay awake
options.zh: 整晚看吵闹的电视，帮助大脑保持清醒

options.en: Never go to bed
options.zh: 永远不睡觉

explain.en: The book suggests a steady sleep schedule and a quiet wind-down help the body know it is time to rest
explain.zh: 书中建议，固定的作息时间和安静的睡前放松能让身体知道该休息了

q.en: How is sleep like recharging a battery?
q.zh: 睡眠为什么像给电池充电？

options.en: It sends us to space
options.zh: 它把我们送进太空

options.en: It uses up more energy so we need extra food and longer rest
options.zh: 它消耗更多能量，所以我们需要额外进食和更长的休息

options.en: It makes us heavier
options.zh: 它让我们变重

options.en: It gives us back the energy we used during the day
options.zh: 它让我们补回白天消耗的能量

explain.en: The book compares sleep to charging a battery so we wake up refreshed and ready to learn
explain.zh: 书中把睡眠比作给电池充电，让我们醒来时精神焕发、准备好学习

q.en: What is the author's purpose in writing this book?
q.zh: 作者写这本书的目的是什么？

options.en: To teach cooking
options.zh: 教人做饭

options.en: To sell mattresses only
options.zh: 仅仅为了卖床垫

options.en: To entertain with a scary story about monsters that never sleep
options.zh: 用一个关于永远不睡觉的怪物的恐怖故事来娱乐

options.en: To teach why sleep matters and how to get it
options.zh: 讲解睡眠为何重要以及如何获得好睡眠

explain.en: The book is informational; it aims to help readers understand and value healthy sleep
explain.zh: 这是一本知识性书籍，旨在帮助读者理解并重视健康的睡眠

q.en: Who needs sleep, according to the book?
q.zh: 根据这本书，谁需要睡眠？

options.en: Everyone, including children and adults
options.zh: 每个人，包括孩子和成人

options.en: Only cats
options.zh: 只有猫

options.en: No one needs sleep because the body runs on its own
options.zh: 没有人需要睡眠，因为身体会自行运转

options.en: Only old people
options.zh: 只有老人

explain.en: The book makes clear that people of all ages need sleep to stay healthy and alert
explain.zh: 书中明确指出，各个年龄段的人都需要睡眠，才能保持健康和清醒

prompt.en: Make a 'sleep plan' for a healthy week. What time would you go to bed and what calm activity would you do first?
prompt.zh: 为健康的一周制定一个“睡眠计划”。你会几点睡觉？睡前会先做哪种安静的活动？

en: Pick a regular bedtime for school nights
Choose one quiet activity before sleep (read, stretch, dim lights)
Explain why good sleep helps you learn and play
zh: 为上学日选一个固定的睡觉时间
选择一项睡前的安静活动（阅读、伸展、调暗灯光）
解释为什么良好的睡眠有助于你学习和玩耍
